svg.title: Multi Admin Approval governance and read-only reporting
svg.desc: An admin raises a device wipe which the MAA access policy turns into an approval request that a PIM-activated approver from a custom-role group approves or rejects. Separately a read-only managed identity lists the requests over Graph, alerts the service desk which raises a ticket, and writes a durable history CSV that Power BI reports on. The reporting layer only reads.
